CognitoAccessToken.description: Amazon Cognito access token. API Gateway requires the operation-specific scope; ID tokens are not accepted for protected application APIs.

x-cognito-scopes.aipavilion/user: Signed-in user APIs. Fine-grained ownership remains server-side.
x-cognito-scopes.aipavilion/tenant: Tenant APIs. Membership, role, ownership and entitlement remain server-side.
x-cognito-scopes.aipavilion/platform-admin: Platform administration APIs. The backend also requires the Cognito admin group.
